# VADPCM decoder

Unmodified `codec/decode.c`, `codec/vadpcm.h` and `LICENSE.txt` from
https://github.com/rasky/vadpcm at commit
`d2facb736fc57cdd01deafa65d37c76669526ac3` (checked 2026-11-10).
Copyright 2022 Dietrich Epp; Mozilla Public License 2.0.
Only the decoder is linked. C11 is enabled on this separate target for MSVC.
These exact sources and license accompany portable packages in
`dependency-sources/vadpcm/`; no ROM samples are distributed.
